description.en: Public catalog. Installation requires access to the private GitHub repositories.
description.zh: 公开目录，安装需要私有 GitHub 仓库的读取权限。

description.en: Short next-prompt suggestions, typo correction, deep rewriting and plain-language summaries.
description.zh: 预测简短的下一句，纠正笔误、深度改写，并用大白话总结回复。

description.en: Connect your DSH to a self-hosted center and use it from any browser.
description.zh: 将电脑接入自己的设备中心，在手机、平板浏览器中使用同一份 DSH 会话。

description.en: Keeps a small, version-stamped index of how to develop for the installed DeepSeek Harness, rebuilt when the local DSH version changes. Other AI harnesses read the bundled skill to get started.
description.zh: 把本机安装的 DSH 投影成一份带版本戳的小索引，DSH 版本变化时自动重建；其他 AI harness 读附带的 skill 即可上手开发。

description.en: Container bundle for composable DSH UI sub-plugins: toggle, compose and remove them like plugins. The bundled Pinned/Unread sub-plugin expands a floating list inside the left column with pinned sessions first and background-finished unread sessions after them.
description.zh: 可组合 DSH 界面子插件的容器：像插件一样开关、组合、卸载。内置「置顶/未读」子插件——点侧栏入口就在左侧栏就地展开浮层，置顶会话在前、后台跑完未读的在后，点一下即切换。
独立富文本笔记、时间轴与层级待办；本机中心存储，支持草稿、附件与阿源摘要。
description.en: Independent rich-text notes, timeline and nested tasks with local-centered storage, drafts, attachments and Ayuan summaries.

description.zh: 阿源：跨设备共享记忆与状态的 DSH 助手（独立浮框、真实 Agent 会话、记忆与页面上下文）。2.0.9 合并上游 2.0.8，并保留两个本地悬浮按钮补丁。
description.en: Ayuan: a shared-memory DSH assistant with a floating conversation panel and real agent sessions. 2.0.9 rebases onto upstream 2.0.8 and keeps two local launcher patches.

description.zh: 可扩展的快捷悬浮球：与阿源气泡成组拖动和贴边；0.2.1 保持面板打开时仍可见、贴边位置钳制在视口内。
description.en: Extensible quick-action launcher that docks and drags with the Ayuan bubble; 0.2.1 keeps it visible while the panel is open and clamps docked positions into the viewport.

description.zh: 豆包式实时语音通话：点电话图标即可用语音和阿源连续对话；语音前台只负责快速回应，真正的任务交给阿源工作区里的会话执行（没有打开的会话会自动新建一张「语音通话」）并语音回报（自动管理远端语音服务和隧道）。
description.en: Doubao-style realtime voice call: click the phone icon and talk to Ayuan; the voice front desk answers fast and hands real work to Ayuan in the Ayuan workspace session, auto-creating a dedicated voice session when none is open, then speaks the result (manages the remote voice service and tunnel automatically).
Transcribe audio and video with the host GPU Qwen3-ASR, including speaker diarization and voiceprint recognition, and gather meeting or screen recordings from other computers.
description.zh: 用本机 GPU 的 Qwen3-ASR 转写录音与视频，带说话人分离和声纹识别，并汇聚其他电脑的会议与录屏。

description.en: Full native temporary sessions with tabs, parent-context updates, source-preserving merges, editable returns and same-session promotion.
description.zh: 原生临时 /btw 浮窗：多标签、上下文跟随、多选融合、可编辑带回与同身份转正。

description.en: Query explicitly selected WeChat contacts and groups. No message sending.
description.zh: 查询明确选择的微信联系人与群聊；不提供发送消息功能。
